title: Atlas delivery SLA - archived
text: Atlas delivery performance target is 90% on-time shipments per calendar month. Delivered on or before the promised date means on-time. Review late delivery exceptions monthly.

title: Atlas delivery SLA - current
text: Atlas delivery performance target is 95% on-time shipments per calendar month. Delivered on or before the promised date means on-time. A missed target triggers a carrier review. Monetary credits require contract-owner approval; no automatic credit amount is specified.

title: Beacon delivery SLA
text: Beacon on-time delivery performance target is 92% per calendar month. Record late shipment exceptions before requesting a carrier review.

title: Cedar delivery SLA
text: Cedar on-time delivery performance target is 95% per calendar month. Record late delivery with a shipment ID and exception reason. Escalate a missed monthly target to the carrier manager.

title: Late delivery escalation policy
text: For late delivery, confirm promised and delivered dates, collect affected shipment IDs, and notify the carrier manager. For vehicle breakdown exceptions, request a recovery plan. For weather exceptions, document the incident. Exception codes alone do not establish causality.

title: Delivery performance calculation
text: On-time delivery rate is 100 multiplied by on-time shipments divided by total delivered shipments in the calendar month. Changes between percentages are reported in percentage points. No rate can be calculated without records.
